questions.prompt: Why was the library built on the old bus depot site?

options.text: It was close to the city centre.
The council already owned the land.
It was near the railway station.

questions.explanation: 'the land was already owned by the city, which saved a great deal of money'.
questions.trap: C is a benefit mentioned afterwards, not the reason for choosing it.

questions.prompt: What is special about the library's opening hours?

options.text: It opens earlier than other libraries.
It is open every day of the year.
It stays open later than others in the region.

questions.explanation: 'later than any other public library in the region'.

questions.prompt: What do new members need to bring?
questions.explanation: 'bring proof of your address'. A photo is NOT needed — staff take one.

questions.prompt: Which environmental feature does the speaker find most impressive?
